standing: Exact schema source bytes for RUST3-LIM's implementing units: D2b copies each candidate to its product path. The handshake candidate already contains FA-2's edits, so it replaces FA-2's handshake candidate as the materialization source; FA-2 binds first. Those units also add the new schema's source-map and admission rows, re-pin the registries and regenerate carriers, which this map does not fix. Independent review and root assent are required before selection.
